Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Talia Grelan: 27-year-old man, 199 cm (very-tall), plus-size heavy construction with substantial natural mass, skin value band-3-light-medium. Face: broad oval face; high cheekbones and softly lidded eyes; prominent bridge, compact mouth; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blue-teal, medium-loose, deliberate accent: offset braid. Wardrobe: fitted-vest-system, specifically a fitted cloth vest system over a soft shirt, high-waist trousers, and flexible boots; offset closures and narrow reinforced cuffs; bounded palette marigold-green. Visible personal details: no accessory and no tattoo. Make the garment hem and outer silhouette the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: meticulous daily maintenance. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: feet plant evenly while fingertips touch a small personal keepsake. Include a small empty medicine pouch only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
